targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  sa.created_at AS "Дата",
  sa.alert_type AS "Тип",
  COALESCE(u_student.name, sa.student_id::text, '—') AS "Менти",
  COALESCE(u_resp.name, (sa.details->>'respondent_id'), '—') AS "Респондент",
  st.title AS "Опрос",
  sa.details->>'question' AS "Вопрос",
  sa.details->>'score' AS "Оценка",
  sa.details->>'threshold' AS "Порог",
  CASE WHEN sa.notified THEN 'Да' ELSE 'Нет' END AS "Уведомлено"
FROM surveys.survey_alerts sa
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = sa.session_id
JOIN surveys.survey_templates st ON st.id = ss.template_id
LEFT JOIN iam.users u_student ON u_student.telegram_id = sa.student_id
LEFT JOIN iam.users u_resp ON u_resp.telegram_id = ss.respondent_id
WHERE sa.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ($__all = '${alert_type}' OR sa.alert_type::text IN (${alert_type:singlequote}))
ORDER BY sa.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', a.created_at) AS time,
  st.slug AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(a.value_int)::numeric, 2) AS value
FROM surveys.survey_answers a
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = a.session_id
JOIN surveys.survey_templates st ON st.id = ss.template_id
WHERE a.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.status = 'completed'
  AND a.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  a.created_at AS "Дата",
  st.title AS "Опрос",
  sq.title AS "Вопрос",
  a.value_int AS "Оценка",
  COALESCE(u.name, ss.respondent_id::text) AS "Респондент"
FROM surveys.survey_answers a
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = a.session_id
JOIN surveys.survey_templates st ON st.id = ss.template_id
JOIN surveys.survey_questions sq ON sq.id = a.question_id
LEFT JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = ss.respondent_id
WHERE a.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND a.value_int <= 4
  AND ss.status = 'completed'
  AND a.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  st.slug AS "Опрос",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss.status = 'completed') AS "Завершено",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss.status != 'completed') AS "Не завершено"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
JOIN surveys.survey_templates st ON st.id = ss.template_id
WHERE ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY st.slug
ORDER BY st.slug

SELECT
  ss.created_at AS "Создан",
  st.title AS "Опрос",
  COALESCE(u.name, ss.respondent_id::text) AS "Респондент",
  ss.status AS "Статус",
  ss.reminder_sent_at AS "Напоминание",
  ss.mentor_notified_at AS "Ментор уведомлён",
  ss.escalated_at AS "Эскалировано"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
JOIN surveys.survey_templates st ON st.id = ss.template_id
LEFT JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = ss.respondent_id
WHERE ss.is_escalatable = true
  AND ss.status != 'completed'
  AND ss.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND (ss.reminder_sent_at IS NOT NULL OR ss.mentor_notified_at IS NOT NULL OR ss.escalated_at IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY ss.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT
  sa.created_at AS "Дата",
  COALESCE(u_student.name, sa.student_id::text, '—') AS "Менти",
  sa.details->>'slug' AS "Опрос менти",
  sa.details->>'paired_slug' AS "Опрос ментора",
  (sa.details->>'avg_current')::numeric AS "Средняя (менти)",
  (sa.details->>'avg_paired')::numeric AS "Средняя (ментор)",
  (sa.details->>'diff')::numeric AS "Разница"
FROM surveys.survey_alerts sa
LEFT JOIN iam.users u_student ON u_student.telegram_id = sa.student_id
WHERE sa.alert_type = 'cross_mismatch'
  AND sa.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY (sa.details->>'diff')::numeric DESC
LIMIT 100
